newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Foreign funds boost investment in Colombian stocks.
newsitem.headline: Foreign funds boost investment in Colombian stocks.

text.p: Foreign funds increased their Colombian shareholdings by 28.9 percent in real peso terms in January compared with the same period last year, the Securities Superintendency said Wednesday.
It said foreign funds held 1.1 trillion pesos, the equivalent of $1.02 million, in Colombian shares as of the end of January.
The 15 funds authorized to purchase Colombian ADRs or GDRs, or global depositary receipts, had accumulated investments of 490.7 billion pesos, the superintendency said.
